items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Bob Woodley and them used to work with Juan in them.

ctx.x: Bob was a little short dumb fella. Bob used to play ghetto. We called him Bob Woodley. I never heard of him before. I don't know a thing about him. Yeah. Bob Woodley. Was he? Yeah, he was good. Did he have his own band, Bob Woodley? No. Bob Woodley and them used to work with Juan in them.
You know. He used to work with Juan in them. He used to work with me.
